hints.content:
To determine “whose pizza dough uses more yeast” we must determine which recipe has more yeast  per cup of flour.  Let’s start with Roland's recipe.  The ratio of yeast to flour in Roland's pizza dough is

$\red2:\blue{3}$.  

How can we use this to compare the two recipes?

We can divide both sides of the ratio by $\green3$ to get the *unit rate*: 

$\dfrac{\red2}{\green3}:\dfrac{\blue3}{\green 3}$, or $\dfrac{2}{3}:1$.

Roland uses $\dfrac{2}{3}$ package of yeast for $1$ cup of flour.

Let's look at Pizza World's recipe.  

 First, let’s find the *unit rate*: how much yeast does Pizza World use for $1$ cup of flour?  

Pizza World uses $\red {4\red {\text{ p}}}$ of yeast for $\blue {7.5 \text{ c}}$  of flour.  So they use

$\begin{align}\dfrac{\red{4\,\text{p}}}{\blue{7.5\,\text{c}}} 
&=\dfrac{\red{4\,\text{p}}}{\blue{\dfrac{15}{2} \text{c}}}\\
&=\red{4\,\text{p}}\cdot\blue{\dfrac{2}{15\,\text{c}}}\\
&=\dfrac{8\,\text{p}}{15\,\text{c}}\\
&=\dfrac{8}{15}\text{p}/\text{c} \end{align}$

This is the *unit rate*.  Similarly, we see that they use $\red8$ packages of yeast for $\blue{15}$ cups of flour:

$\dfrac{\red8 \,\text{p}}{{\blue{15}}\, \text{c}}= \dfrac{8}{15} \text{p}/\text{c}$,

which is the same rate.  The last entry in the table also gives this rate:

$\dfrac{\red{12} \,\text{p}}{{\blue{22.5}}\, \text{c}}= \dfrac{8}{15} \text{p}/\text{c}$.
Next, we see that $\dfrac{2}{3}=\dfrac{10}{15}$ , which is greater than $\dfrac{8}{15}$ , so Roland uses more yeast than Pizza World.

question.content:
Roland is a fantastic cook.  He always makes his own pizza dough.  He uses $2$ packages $(\text{p})$ of yeast  for every $3$ cups $(\text{c})$ of flour.  

Pizza World makes pizza dough according to the  chart below.

**Whose pizza dough uses more yeast per cups of flour?**

Yeast $(\text{p})$|Flour $(\text{c})$
:-:|:-:
$4$|$7.5$
$8$|$15$
$12$|$22.5$

[[☃ radio 1]]

choices.content: They use the same amount of yeast.
